text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we still have 3 open items: owner handoff for the cache mitigation, add regression evals, and consolidate the incident-pattern notes. Who can pick which?
joe: I can pick the mitigation and open the ticket. Will include a short rollback plan.
tess: I'll own the regression evals + thresholds. Will write an automated check that runs in CI.
sam: I'll consolidate the incident-pattern notes and run the log correlation so we can see recurrence rate.
pm-bot: Jira RW-3991 created by @joe - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-3991
joe: RW-3991: Reduce KV retention window + add eviction pressure metrics. Assignee=joe. ETA: PR by 2026-04-04. Acceptance criteria to add: no sustained kv_cache_size increase >12% under synthetic workload for 24h.
tess: For evals: I'll add a nightly regression that runs the 'long-prefix-burst' generator and compares kv metrics to baseline. AC: CI fails if 95th percentile memory increases >8%.
sam: For pattern mapping, I found 3 past incidents with matching signatures (eviction bursts and sudden kv growth). I'll paste the grep commands and attach snippets to RW-3991 under Diagnostics.
maria: Please also add a tiny RACI so oncall knows who to escalate to during canary. Propose: Joe=R, Tess=A (evals), Sam=C, Maria=I.
joe: Handing docs/rollout to @tess for the canary checklist; I'll keep code ownership.

# grep snippets Sam will attach
sam: Commands I'll add to the ticket:
```
zgrep "kv_cache_size" /var/log/*/service.log | awk '{print $1,$4,$7}' | sort -k3 -n | tail -n 20
awk '/eviction/ {print $0}' /var/log/incidents.log | sed -n '1,200p'
```

maria: Can we set a short timeline: PR by Apr 4, internal review Apr 6, canary Apr 7-9, close follow-up by Apr 14? If anyone needs more time call it out.
tess: Timeline works for evals. I'll have a draft CI job by Apr 5.
joe: OK for me. If canary shows regressions we rollback and open a follow-on ticket for deep investigation.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled for rw-dedicated-prod by @tess on 2026-04-07T03:00Z
maria: Also add 'close the loop' checklist to the ticket: 1) PR merged, 2) canary stable 48h, 3) regression CI green 7 runs, 4) postmortem updated with final links. Once all checked we mark PM follow-up resolved.
sam: I'll attach the correlation matrix and a short note on recurrence probability (low/medium/high) based on the last 6 months.
joe: Will update RW-3991 with PR link and the RACI table when PR created.
maria: Let's have a 20m sync Tue 2026-04-06 15:00 UTC to confirm PR & CI state. If everything looks green we close the PM ticket by Apr 14.
joe: ack :thumbsup:
tess: ack
sam: ack
pm-bot: Reminder created: PM follow-up RW-3991 sync - 2026-04-06 15:00 UTC
